description: an ancient forest goddess, a slim woman with light skin, long silver-grey hair in two braids woven with moss and small flowers hanging straight down her back at rest, not flying, eyes glowing green, a crown of branching brown antlers with small green leaves and white blossoms, a long pale grey robe like birch bark with a green sash, a long cloak of living green vines and moss with small pink and white flowers hanging behind from the shoulders, brown leather boots, a kind wise woman's face in clean profile with one eye, no staff, no roots, no tree of light and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the tips of the antlers to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same character seen from the side: face, braids, antler crown, robe, vine cloak, colours and drawing style; not the sitting pose and not the hands on the reins: she stands and walks
the character's look in detail: face, braids, antler crown, robe, vine cloak and colours; the hands empty, without the blossoming staff, the roots and the tree of light
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, upright mid-step, not turned towards the viewer; copy it exactly
